messages:
Maya (support): heads up — CartaFlow reported sustained 429s against their Dedicated instance starting ~09:10 UTC. They say requests keep getting routed to `shared-throttle-pool` instead of their reserved pool. customer observed higher token billing due to retries. attaching repro steps and two request ids: req-0a1b2c3d, req-0a1b2c3e
Devon (oncall): thanks. can you paste the inbound headers + x-routing metadata (if available)? any recent changes to routing policies? @Sofia FYI
Maya (support): here's minimal repro (sanitized):
```
POST /v1/generate
Authorization: Bearer <redacted>
X-Redwood-Tier: gold,plan=enterprise
X-Tenant-ID: carta-123
X-Request-Id: req-0a1b2c3d
```
Response: 429 Too Many Requests (routed to pool=shared-throttle-pool)
Maya (support): customer says this started right after we pushed the tier-header parsing change on 03/04 that accepts comma-separated tiers.
Devon (oncall): running quick check on control-plane logs for tenant carta-123 now...
infra-bot: [autoscaler] 2024-03-05T09:05:22Z scaledown pool dedicated-carta-1 -> desired=0 (idle)
Liam (eng-runtime): the logs show routing-decider chose fallback because tier key 'plan' didn't match expected label name 'tier'. possible parse mismatch when header includes commas.
Sofia (eng-infra): digging into policy-2024-03-04: we added support for multi-value Tier header but used `tier` as canonical key while some older configs use `plan`. That created a no-match path which triggers `fallback.shared` routing.
Devon (oncall): that explains wrong pool selection -> requests go to shared pool and hit rate caps -> 429s. mitigation?
Sofia (eng-infra): immediate mitigation: pin carta-123 to their reserved pool via tenant override and revert the parser change in control-plane. executing rollback command now: `/deploy rollback routing/policy-2024-03-04`
infra-bot: deploy started for routing/policy-2024-03-04 rollback by sofia (eng-infra)
Liam (eng-runtime): also adding a safe guard: if tenant has reserved pool and routing key parse produces no match, prefer tenant binding instead of shared fallback. will send PR with tests.
Devon (oncall): made tenant override: `tenant:carta-123 -> pool: dedicated-carta-1` (temp)
infra-bot: deploy succeeded for routing/policy-2024-03-04 rollback (duration 35s)
Sofia (eng-infra): rollback live. control-plane logs now show route resolved to dedicated-carta-1 for incoming requests with either `tier` or `plan`.
Maya (support): customer confirmed after ~2m they stopped seeing 429s and retries. billing spike question: they had ~1.8x token consumption from retries during incident window, can Billing team be looped?
Devon (oncall): noted, @Finance or @BillingOps please advise re: one-off credit. I'll collect request ids and timeframe: 2024-03-05T09:10-09:18 UTC.
Liam (eng-runtime): followups: add unit test for comma-separated header parsing + add integration test that tenant override precedence > fallback pool. Filing #TI-3421
Sofia (eng-infra): root cause: control-plane routing policy used keyset lookup that didn't include legacy `plan` key after parser refactor. Fix: parser now normalizes both `tier` and `plan` -> mapping table updated.
Maya (support): saving timeline and repro into the support ticket. customer is satisfied for now. closing the high-priority escalation after Billing follow-up. :white_check_mark:
Devon (oncall): great work, team. put a short postmortem note in #incidents with link to PR and ticket.
Liam (eng-runtime): PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/ctrl-plane/pulls/678 — includes tests + migration notes.
Sofia (eng-infra): will monitor for 30m, will reopen if anomalies. infra alerts show 429 rate for dedicated-carta-1 dropped from 48/min -> 3/min after rollback.
Maya (support): thanks everyone.
